headline: Residential cruise operator enters liquidation amid high marine fuel costs
summary: A US-based cruise operator offering long-term voyages for retirees halted services and went bust, stranding passengers in Cambodia after blaming an ongoing marine fuel crisis for unsustainable operating expenses.
why: Rising bunker fuel costs create severe liquidity stress for niche cruise lines with high fixed fuel exposures and limited hedging operations.

impacts.name: Maritime Shipping
impacts.why: Sustained fuel cost spikes increase operating losses across unhedged passenger shipping operators.
